src.q: Indapamide is a sulfonamide derivative with an indole ring, pharmacologically related to thiazide diuretics
Each tablet contains Amiloride hydrochloride 5mg and hydrochlorothiazide 50mg
The combination of atenolol with thiazide-like diuretics has been shown to be compatible
Thiazides and related diuretics including indapamide
Pharmacotherapeutic group: Diuretic and potassium-sparing agent
Amiloride hydrochloride is a potassium-sparing diuretic.
is indicated in essential hypertension in adults.
If blood pressure is not sufficiently lowered with a dose of 25 mg/day, combined treatment with another antihypertensive drug is recommended.
In hypertension, Co-amilozide may be used alone or in conjunction with other antihypertensive agents.
Tenoretic tablets combines the antihypertensive activity of two agents
Treatment of moderate to severe hypertension.
Pharmacotherapeutic group: antihypertensives, antiadrenergic agents, centrally acting, imidazoline receptor agonists

notes: ATTENTION atenolol-chlortalidone: the clinic lists Tenoretic as atenolol + bendroflumethiazide, but UK Tenoretic (and Tenoret 50/12.5) is atenolol + CHLORTALIDONE. No UK atenolol + bendroflumethiazide combination exists on emc or MHRA Products. The file is built from the UK Tenoretic/Tenoret SmPCs (emc 5497, 5498), with name set to Atenolol/chlortalidone and ingredients [atenolol, chlortalidone]; vocab name and clinic generic need correcting (or switch to no-uk-product if the clinic really stocks a bendroflumethiazide product). Allergy rule uses master id atenolol-chlortalidone because chlortalidone is not a vocab ingredient. | hydrochlorothiazide: no single-ingredient product on emc; UK SPC taken from MHRA Products (Aspire Pharma 25 mg, PL 35533/0305, blob URL found via the MHRA products search index). Esidrex is not a UK product. | New group non-antibiotic-sulfonamide (thiazides, thiazide-like and loop diuretics) created so SmPC sulfonamide cross-allergy contraindications can fire without adding diuretics to the antibiotic sulfonamide group (SPS: cross-reactivity antibiotic vs non-antibiotic not expected). Other batches can add sulfonylureas, celecoxib, etc. | Conflicts kept as separate items/rules: moxonidine SmPCs differ (Physiotens emc 6660: contraindicated in severe heart failure and GFR<30, not under 18; Sandoz emc 4138: contraindicated in any cardiac insufficiency, allows max 0.3 mg/day at GFR<30, not under 16). Furosemide: emc 12129 pregnancy must not be given unless compelling reasons vs emc 100580 should not be used unless benefit outweighs risk; emc 100580 4.6 says caution in breastfeeding while its 4.3 contraindicates breastfeeding; emc 100580 gives 250-1500 mg/day for chronic renal insufficiency despite CrCl<30 contraindication. Tenoretic SmPC contraindicates pregnancy/lactation while BUMPS and SPS (atenolol alone) allow use with caution. Methyldopa 4.3 says not recommended for phaeochromocytoma, 4.4 says contraindicated (rule uses contraindicated). | Co-amilozide SmPC 4.3 contraindicates diabetes mellitus (all), hypercalcaemia, lithium; age<18 is in 4.3 so mapped contraindicated. | No SPS breastfeeding or monitoring pages found for thiazides, indapamide, amiloride, methyldopa or moxonidine (only furosemide monitoring and beta-blockers breastfeeding). No BUMPS leaflet for moxonidine, indapamide or furosemide individually (BUMPS diuretics leaflet used). BNF not accessed. | AUDIT 2026-10-17 (second check, log audit/L-M.md): diuretic membership quote for indapamide replaced (the ATC line did not say diuretic). MHRA HCTZ skin-cancer DSU now uses batch K id mhra-dsu-hctz-nmsc-2018; condition non-melanoma-skin-cancer-history replaced by batch K id skin-cancer-history. Aspirin high-dose rules removed from indapamide and hydrochlorothiazide (all master aspirin is 75 mg); systemic-corticosteroid rules now name prednisolone and dexamethasone (group corticosteroid includes inhaled/nasal products). Indapamide deliberately NOT in qt-prolonging (not on SPS list; SmPC links QT prolongation to hypokalaemia). Integrator: add chlortalidone to vocab ingredients and rename atenolol-chlortalidone to atenolol-chlortalidone (or make it no-uk-product if the clinic confirms a bendroflumethiazide product).
